name: oyren-welcome
description: How this sandbox works — the walkthrough the middle pane opens on first boot.

walkthroughs.title: Welcome to Oyren
walkthroughs.description: Your agent, your editor, one sandbox — five things worth knowing.

steps.title: This is a sandbox, and it is yours
steps.description: A dedicated machine was started for this session. The agent you launched works here — and so can you: same files, same shell, same tools. Close the tab and everything keeps running.

steps.title: One chat, every CLI agent
steps.description:
The Chat panel talks to the agent this session runs — and the agent-type picker at the bottom of its input can open a session for any of the seven CLI agents on the same files.
[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: The terminal is live in two places
steps.description:
The default terminal profile attaches to the same tmux session the Oyren app's Terminal pane shows — one conversation, two screens. The profile dropdown can also start any other agent, or a plain bash.
[Open Terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new)

steps.title: Files sync with your workspace
steps.description: Everything under /home/oyren/workspace is the session's working copy. The agent's edits show up here live, and your saves are what the agent reads next.

steps.title: Sessions are paid by the hour
steps.description: The countdown in the Oyren header shows the paid runtime left; +1h extends it, repeatably, up to the session's cap. The editor keeps working right up to the deadline.
